mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School under a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 60 degrees, and rain is in the forecast.

The City of Verona continues its contract with AECOM for engineering services, with detailed reports presented to the City Council. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding public meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study on November 18 and 19 to discuss new design concepts.

There is plenty to do in town this week. Yoga at Insight Wellness is tomorrow, followed by Art House 360 events and trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow. Looking further ahead, we have music at Bailey's Run and the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event on October 30.

In police news, on October 25, officers responded to a call where a 40-year-old Verona man was found stopped at an intersection for over 20 minutes. He was taken into custody for an O W I, marking his first offence.

The Culver's flavor of the day was Chocolate Heath Crunch. As the store is now closed for the night, you can look forward to the OREO REESE'S Cheesecake flavor tomorrow when the shop opens at 10:00 AM.
